notes.title: A Quick Note About Developer Responses
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It’s hard to believe it’s already been almost a month since the demo ended.[/p][p]Originally, we had hoped to wrap up internal discussions and share our responses to the feedback and suggestions you sent in around this time. However, after the demo, we also allowed ourselves a brief pause to reset and refocus — so we’ll need just a little more time before we can share those replies with you. 🤣[/p][p][/p][p]Please know that we’re reviewing all of your feedback carefully, one by one, and rather than rushing out quick answers, we want to respond with thoughtful, well-considered replies.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be back with an update as soon as everything is ready — thank you for your patience![/p]

notes.title: 🏁 July Demo Recap
notes.content:
[p][i](Made a couple quick tweaks to the original post since a few things changed)[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Can you believe it’s already been a week since the demo ended?
We launched it full of hope (and nerves), and ever since, it’s been nonstop on our side.[/p][p][/p][p]Between reading through your heartfelt feedback and digging into gameplay stats to see what you all enjoyed the most, the days just flew by.[/p][p][/p][p]So today, we wanted to take a moment to reflect — and share a little recap of how things went![/p][p][/p][h2]📊 [u][i][b]DEMO, By the Numbers[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302109/c7a4b255894439c104f3844ee205bfcb52f7a44f.png"][/img][/p][p]We couldn’t fit everything into the infographic, but while preparing this recap post, we came across a few extra fun stats that were too good not to share.[/p][p][/p][h5]🧠 [b]Best K/D vehicle:[/b] [i]Sniper[/i] (Avg. 3.8/1)[/h5][list][*][p]Hunter and Raider may have been the most popular picks, but in the end, the true winner was Sniper 🤩 Let’s be honest — if the opponent Sniper knows how to position well… it’s pretty much game over 😂[/p][/*][/list][h5]💀 [b]Mode with the most kills:[/b] [i]Core Battle[/i] (avg. 11 kills)[/h5][list][*][p]Okay, this one caught us off guard… We assumed TDM mode would have the highest kill count, but nope — Core Battle ended up being the bloodbath. (For reference: TDM averaged just 6 kills.)
…You do all realize that the win condition in Core Battle is capturing the core, not blowing up cars… right? 😂[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]💬 [u][i][b]What Was the Community Saying?[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve gathered a few kind and encouraging messages from Reddit, YouTube, and Discord — and just wanted to say: every single one of those comments meant the world to us. They gave us confidence, kept us motivated, and reminded us we’re on the right track.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302109/1674f3fe69641af60558ee769190d45c45eb29fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🔧 [u][i][b]Feedback Highlights from the Demo[/b][/i][/u][/h2][p][/p][p]We received a ton of great suggestions, bug reports, and general “this could be better” notes. [/p][p]Thank you again to everyone who took the time to share their thoughts. While we can't go over every single suggestion in this post, we’ve pulled together a few of the most frequently mentioned points below.[/p][p][/p][h5][b]🤖 “AI bots feel way too unbalanced.”[/b][/h5][list][*][p]Yep — this came up [i]a lot[/i]. Many of you had matches that felt super one-sided because of the AI, and we get it. We’ll be working to reduce those unfair moments in future builds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h5]🖥️ [b]“Please add Split Screen mode!”[/b][/h5][list][*][p]We didn’t expect this one, but wow — it showed up a lot. Time to sit down with Gonzalo and see if we can move up the timeline for local co-op.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]That wraps up this little look back at our 3-day demo!
Maybe you’ll find some of this relatable — or maybe you learned something you hadn’t noticed before.[/p][p]Either way, we hope you enjoyed this recap as much as we enjoyed putting it together. Think of it not as a dev update, but as a shared memory we made together 🤩[/p][p] [/p][quote][p]P.S.[/p][p]We also know that with the demo being on the shorter side, some of you waited patiently but still didn’t get a chance to join in — and honestly, we’re just as bummed about that as you are.[/p][p]Next time, we’ll make sure the schedule gives everyone more time to jump in and enjoy the ride properly.[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more fun things to share 👍[/p]

notes.title: Thank You for an Incredible Demo Week
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! gonzalo here again ! [/p][p]Looking back, this demo week has honestly been amazing for us. [/p][p][/p][p]Seeing so many of you genuinely enjoying the game felt incredibly rewarding, and at the same time, your feedback gave us a crystal-clear picture of what needs improvement. [/p][p]Especially after seeing those AI bots acting like total clowns and slowly destroying your competitive spirit… yeah, that one hurt. Believe me, it’s already high on our priority list. [/p][p][/p][p]A huge thanks to all of you who took the time to provide detailed feedback, we truly appreciate it. We’ll be carefully organizing and considering every single suggestion because we want to make sure your voices are not just heard, but actually reflected in future versions of the game. [/p][p][/p][p]I really hope you stick around with us, because we’re just getting started. And to everyone who joined the demo, thank you again from the bottom of my heart. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be back soon with more updates, stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Matchmaking Improvement
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone ! [/p][p][/p][p]We've noticed that many players have been getting matched primarily with bots — and while that's still playable, we believe Rivals Hover League is at its best when played with real players. [/p][p][/p][p]To help improve the matchmaking experience and increase the chances of playing with actual players, we've decided to temporarily re-organize the servers so everyone is in the same match making pool. [/p][p]This change may have a slight impact on your ping or latency, but we believe it will still remain within an acceptable range for most players and will be a more fun experience overall. [/p][p]However, if we detect any major issues after this change we'll respond and make adjustments as quickly as possible. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your understanding, and see you in the arena.[/p]

notes.title: 🚀 Demo is now live ! (July 25–28)
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone ! 🔥[/p][p][/p][p]The long-awaited demo is now open ![/p][p]Starting right now, anyone can freely join the [i]Rivals Hover League[/i] demo — just head over to the “[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3779620/Rivals_Hover_League_Demo/"]Demo Page[/url][i][b]”[/b][/i] and experience RHL for yourself.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]❗ Before you jump in, a few things to keep in mind:[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ You may run into some “quirky” bugs[/b][/h3][p]The game is still deep in development, so it’s possible you’ll encounter small bugs or unexpected behaviors during the demo. We hope you’ll see them as part of the process — and if you do come across anything odd, we’d love to hear about it![/p][list][*][p][i][b]📘 [/b][/i][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3251280/discussions/0/604162514919504060/"]\[Demo FAQ][/url][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]🐞 [/b][/i][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3251280/discussions/0/604162514919504242/"]\[Things to Know Before Playing the Demo][/url][/p][list][*][p]To report bugs 👉 [url="https://discord.gg/JS56e9TUcZ"]head over here[/url][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]💬 Your feedback really matters[/b][/h3][p]After playing, we’d really appreciate your thoughts.
You can fill out the “[url="https://rivals.news/demosurvey"][i][b]in-game survey[/b][/i][/url][i][b]”[/b][/i] or give us some advice at the “[i][b]Sharing Ideas” post[/b][/i] comment section — every bit of feedback helps us improve RHL and shape what comes next.[/p][p] [/p][h3][b]⚠️ Progress will reset after the demo[/b][/h3][p]Please note that all demo progress (levels, rankings, missions, etc.) will be wiped after the demo period ends. [/p][p]We will, however, keep your account ID for future rewards 👀[/p][p]Lastly, we would like to share a heartfelt message from Gonzalo (g0nch0), Game Director at EF Games, to express the team’s genuine sentiments as we prepare to unveil the game for the very first time.[/p][p] [/p][quote][p][b]Hey everyone, g0nch0 here, Game Director of RHL from EF Games![/b][/p][p]The demo for Rivals Hover League officially begins today and to be totally honest, it feels a bit scary.[/p][p]This isn't a super polished showcase version yet. It’s pretty raw, heavily focused on core gameplay, and still very much a work-in-progress. You’ll probably find rough edges, placeholder content, or maybe a bug or two that slipped past us. But we’ve put our hearts into this, and felt it was time to start sharing, even if it means showing the game before it’s fully ready.[/p][p]We're really excited for you to finally get your hands on it and feel the game for yourselves. We’d genuinely appreciate your honest, constructive feedback as we move forward—but above all, we just hope you have a good time playing. If you enjoy it, even in its current unfinished form, that alone means a lot to us.[/p][p]Thanks so much for giving it a shot![/p][/quote][p] [/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey with us! ❤
Enjoy the Demo![/p]

notes.content:

That’s why your feedback is especially important![/p][p][/p][p]While playing the demo, if you thought things like [b][i]“I wish this system was added”[/i][/b] or [b][i]“This part could be more fun if improved,” [/i][/b]feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition to things you [b]really think need improvement[/b], feel free to also include any [b]frustrating parts or moments you enjoyed[/b] — they’ll be a huge help as we plan what’s next![/p][p](Detailed feedback is always appreciated, but just a quick sentence or two is totally fine — no pressure! 👍)[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be reviewing all your feedback closely and discussing internally how we can reflect as much of it as possible.[/p][p]Please remember — Sharing Ideas isn’t just about collecting feedback, It’s about exchanging ideas and building a better game together with you.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of this!

notes.title: Dev-Diary #3 — From a Vertical Slice to a Public Alpha Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]I'm Gonzalo, the Game Director of RHL at EF Games[/p][p][/p][p]We're finally here, just a few hours until you can actually play RHL! We can't be more excited and terrified at the same time![/p][p][/p][p]This is a special Dev Diary because this Alpha Demo marks the culmination of seven incredibly intense months of work by the amazing team at EF Games. During these months, we faced the huge challenge of transforming our promising vertical slice into a stable foundation capable of supporting thousands of players. And trust me, it wasn't easy.[/p][p][/p][p]Our vertical slice, the early build you usually prepare to pitch to publishers, already featured the 7 vehicles and 3 arenas you'll see in the demo. In fact, they looked pretty good. All our early trailers and private playtests used that build. The issue was that, behind the scenes, everything was barely held together with duct tape. Most systems had been hastily thrown together to get something playable as fast as possible. The netcode was smoke and mirrors. It [i]seemed[/i] to work fine but in reality, vehicles passed right through each other, shots appeared differently for every player, and plenty of other "small" issues that were okay at that early stage but definitely not good enough for a proper public release.[/p][p][/p][p]So, instead of patching up that shaky version, we decided to rebuild everything PROPERLY. It wasn’t easy, and without the trust and support from Krafton, it would've been impossible. Seriously, what other partner lets you work for half a year, only for it to look like you're releasing the exact SAME game? 😅[/p][p][/p][p]But believe me, this is NOT the same game. While on the outside it might seem familiar, we've practically rebuilt everything from scratch, except models and textures. Imagine a reverse remake: you keep the visuals but redo everything else! To pull it off and ensure RHL can stand shoulder to shoulder with the big players, we had to choose the best possible tech solutions.[/p][p][/p][p]Since we're a pretty small team and RHL is a very ambitious game, we can't afford, and frankly don’t want, to waste time reinventing the wheel. Our goal is clear: focus 100% on making the best possible game, leveraging top, notch third, party technologies to build a stable, tested, and scalable foundation. So, over the last months, we’ve integrated several key technologies that now form the core of the demo you’re about to play:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]■ Photon Quantum[/b][/h2][p]This was by far the biggest change, in terms of time and impact. We needed a reliable networking solution with stable, proven servers worldwide, which also allowed us to keep our carefully crafted driving physics intact. After extensive research, we chose Photon Quantum, a deterministic game engine. Adopting Quantum meant rebuilding ALL gameplay elements from zero: physics, input, AI… literally everything. Thanks to their constant support, we not only matched the original driving feel but significantly IMPROVED and expanded it. Controls are now tighter and more responsive, hover mechanics have way more depth depending on activation and speed, and there are countless other subtle improvements. Thanks to Quantum, we finally have stable collisions between vehicles and, crucially, a future really powerful replay system. We really wanted to include replays and kill cams in this demo but ran out of time. After all, what's the fun in pulling off crazy moves if you can't replay or share them later?[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]■ [b]🆔 Krafton ID Login & User System[/b][/h2][p]As we develop RHL, we know certain online features (matchmaking, friends, cross, platform identity, etc.) require a solid account system. That’s why we integrated Krafton ID, provided by our publishing partner. It was an easy choice, it solves tons of backend headaches, they can customize it to our needs and is totally free for us :D. Plus, this system enables cross, platform play and progression without extra work from us while also helping us navigate the complex realities of operating a global, cross-platform game. A definite win, win.[/p][p]⚠️ [b]IMPORTANT:[/b]
The first time you launch RHL, you'll need to log in or create your Krafton ID account. This links your Krafton ID to Steam, so future logins are automatic. It’s a quick process, but we know even minor extra steps can be annoying, so thanks in advance for your patience! Plus, your reward for playing the demo will be tied directly to your Krafton ID.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]■ 🔊 Kinetic WWISE Audio[/b][/h2][p]Audio is key to immersion, so choosing the industry, leading audio technology was a no, brainer. Although sound effects and music in this demo are still far from our final vision, the foundation is fully implemented and performing exceptionally well.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]■ 🔳 Noesis GUI[/b][/h2][p]Another crucial component is our game's UI. Every developer knows how tedious implementing dynamic UI can be. That’s why we chose Noesis GUI, also, their office is literally around the corner from ours! 😄 With Noesis (used by big AAA titles like Baldur's Gate 3 and most 2K games), our artists can directly implement UI, freeing developers to focus on what really matters, the gameplay. Our UI is still not finished, but this demo is powered by Noesis. And we’re just scratching the surface of what's possible with this powerful tool.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]■ 🔒 Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC)[/b][/h2][p]Since RHL is multiplayer, we knew from the start that we needed a reliable anti-cheat system. We integrated Easy Anti, Cheat (EAC), widely used in many popular games. It's effective, less invasive, and plays nicely with platforms like Steam Deck. Honestly, there weren’t any other good alternatives![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]These past few months have been a true rollercoaster of intense work, rebuilding every system and adapting each one to the new technologies. I’ll be honest: the day we finally managed, after at least four months, to play a proper match together as a team, laughing and yelling like kids again… I almost cried. You make big decisions based on logic, prototypes, and trust, but you never really know if the pieces will click until they do. That moment when it just worked was a huge relief and one of the happiest points of this whole year. Every single tech decision we've made was about one thing: being able to build something solid and efficient that lives up to what you all deserve.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]■ This is an in-development ALPHA DEMO[/b][/h2][p]If you've taken part in early demos or playtests before, you’ll know the drill, there will be bugs, crashes, little oddities here and there. Hopefully nothing too serious! We’ve focused all our efforts on delivering a strong, fun gameplay experience: that feeling of flying at 200 km/h, hovering through a sharp turn, and taking out the rival behind you. And we truly believe we've nailed that part, better than ever, actually.[/p][p]Everything around it is still temporary and very much in progress, but we hope you're having SO much fun mastering the controls and destroying each other that you’ll be happy to overlook the rough edges. That’s the main goal of this version: that you have a blast. And as a bonus goal? That you send us tons of feedback so we can keep making the best version of RHL possible. Like I always say: we’re in this together. Let’s make RHL the best game it can be![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you again for being part of this journey with us, and see you in the arenas! 🚀🔥[/p]

notes.title: Dev-Diary #2 — Behind the Scenes: How KRAFTON Became Our Key Partner
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p][/p][p]For this Dev-Diary, EFGames CEO Joaquín thought it might be fun to share some behind-the-scenes stories—like how he first connected with KRAFTON and how our partnership came to be. So we’ve put together a special post, written in the style of a “letter from the CEO” 😊[/p][p][/p][p]===============================[/p][p][/p][p]Today, I want to talk a bit about something that’s been a huge part of this project behind the scenes, how we ended up partnering with KRAFTON, and what this has meant for us as a dev team. [/p][p][/p][p]Honestly, when we first started building RHL, we didn’t fully understand the scale of the game we were making. It wasn’t until we showcased it at our first Gamescom in 2022 and the positive feedback we received that we realized just how big, complex, and ambitious the game was, and the impact it could have if we did it right. That’s when we understood we needed a strong partner to walk this journey with us. [/p][p][/p][p]Making a game is so much more than just building it: servers, QA, build systems, legal, localization, platform support, community management, marketing... Trying to handle all of that alone would have pushed actual development aside. [/p][p][/p][p]After attending many fairs, GDCs, Gamescoms, and more, we had several publishers express interest until Krafton appeared and showed genuine enthusiasm. For a giant like Krafton, known worldwide for PUBG, to be interested in a small company like us was both an incredible boost of confidence and a huge responsibility. We couldn’t afford to fail. [/p][p][/p][p]Among all interested publishers, what convinced us most about Krafton was their clear commitment to our vision and the understanding they showed of what we wanted to create, not just the genre or the visuals, but the feel we pursued with the game. Why we care so much about the driving feeling, why we’re obsessed with polishing every aspect of the driving and shooting physics. [/p][p][/p][p]A dinner at Gamescom 2023 confirmed the strong connection between Krafton’s and EF Games’ teams, paving the way for the investment and publishing agreement that would take another year to finalize. Of course, contracts are never quick or simple, but throughout the process, one thing was consistent: follow-through. Everything we discussed early on has been honored, and that trust has only grown. [/p][p][/p][p]Now that we work together daily, it’s clear this partnership goes beyond publishing, it’s about building something the right way. [/p][p][/p][p]The biggest impact? We’ve been able to focus, really focus. We had the space to do what we truly want: improve the game, one mechanic, one detail at a time. There’s still a lot ahead, and we’re learning every week. Looking back, partnering with KRAFTON was the right move. Of course, this partnership means we must be mindful of deadlines and quality benchmarks, which adds pressure but also pushes us to deliver our best. It’s been a balancing act, maintaining our creative freedom while aligning with KRAFTON’s expectations, but so far, it’s been an inspiring challenge. [/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to bring you a demo in July that truly reflects the hard work of both teams. We hope it gives you a taste of what we’re building and sparks your enthusiasm as much as it has ours. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us so far! We can’t wait to share more updates soon. Meanwhile, keep an eye on our socials for teasers and sneak peeks. And, as always, your feedback means everything to us ![/p]

notes.title: Dev Q&A #1 Recap - All Your Questions, Answered !
notes.content:
Hey everyone~

Last week, we wrapped up our very first Dev Q&A on Discord, and it was such a fun ride ! 🙌

Our fans asked some really awesome questions, and we thought it’d be great to share our lead developer’s answers here on the Steam Community as well.

Since our dev took the time to carefully respond to each question with a ton of thought and care, we couldn’t quite fit the full replies here due to Steam’s character limit—so we’ve trimmed them down to the key points for this post.

If you hop over to our [url=https://discord.gg/4y79KDc3a6]Discord[/url], you can still check out the full Dev Q&A thread, join in on future sessions, and really get a feel for the dev’s honest thoughts and game philosophy. Come hang out with us!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h4]Q1. Will RHL release on consoles, and will crossplay be supported?[/h4]

✅ We're focusing on PC first to polish the game thoroughly with community feedback during Early Access. But yes, console versions for PlayStation and Xbox are definitely planned. Crossplay is something we're keen on too—once the PC version is solid, we'll start looking into it!


[h4]Q2. Will vehicles have defined roles, similar to Overwatch?[/h4]

✅ Absolutely! Vehicles in RHL each have unique weapons, abilities, and playstyles—think "Overwatch meets Rocket League." You'll find cars built for frontline action, stealthy support, or precision attacks, adding strategic depth and encouraging teamwork. Roles are flexible enough to adapt quickly, keeping gameplay fast, fun, and dynamic !


[h4]Q3. Do you see RHL as a competitive game or more casual?[/h4]

✅ We designed RHL for both. It's easy to pick up for casual players but has deep mechanics for those who want to master it competitively. We’re planning different game modes for both playstyles and will shape the future together with the community.


[h4]Q4. From a dev's perspective, what's the real fun in RHL?[/h4]

✅ It’s all about that mix of speed, precision, and teamwork. The best moments come from pulling off crazy combos or perfectly timed moves with your squad. Every match is built to deliver that one unforgettable moment.


[h4]Q5. What inspired you to create RHL, and what was the hardest part?[/h4]

✅ It all started as a VR experiment—but wild driving mechanics stole the show. The biggest challenge? Making driving and aiming feel fully connected. Thanks to our hover system, you aim by how you drive, which adds a ton of skill and expression.


[h4]Q6. How many vehicle classes will be available at launch?[/h4]

✅ We'll start Early Access with 7 unique vehicles, each with their own weapons, roles, and handling. And yes—we’ve already got more wild ideas cooking.


[h4]Q7: What makes RHL different from other car battle games?[/h4]

✅ Unlike most, RHL blends fast, skillful driving with hero-shooter mechanics. You aim by driving. Our hover system lets you move in one direction and aim in another, creating a totally new kind of feel. It's not just fun—it’s the future of car combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302109/477b159dc81d63487a71a78c8439765a7a6bd908.png[/img]

Our team is excited to showcase a in-game trailer (no fake gameplay!) at the event which we believe will show off the fun you can have in Rivals Hover League !

We're working hard behind the scenes to prepare something playable but need a bit more time since we want to provide a really enjoyable experience for everyone.

So stay tuned to see when you will all get a chance to try Rivals Hover League out for yourselves! (Might also want to consider joining our Discord 😉)

📅 Tune in live on [b]March 20 at 01:00 PM PT[/b] (UTC : March 20 at 08:00 PM / ET : March 20 at 04:00 PM)
📺 [b]Watch it here[/b] : [[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JsFTvIsRYbw]LINK[/url]]

We can’t wait to show you what’s coming next! In the meantime, don’t forget to wishlist the game and join us on Discord! 🚀🔥

See you at the show! 🎬✨

notes.title: Rivals Hover League’s New Logo is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The Rivals Hover League Team here 

It feels like it’s been forever since we last checked in—our last big update was back in December when we announced our participation in Indie Live Expo!

(Truth is, we’ve all been completely heads-down, working non-stop to get the game into your hands as soon as possible!😂)

But today, we’ve got something exciting to share! Our new Rivals Hover League logo is finally complete, and we’re here to show it off! 🎉

Since the logo is the symbol of our game, we felt it was time for an upgrade. We put a lot of thought into refining it, making sure it truly captures the essence of "futuristic sci-fi vibes + high-speed action + sleek, modern art design." After multiple iterations, we’ve finally landed on the final version!

[b]▶ The New Version[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45302109/eaa614ecc2375ba04cd08dd431b17b0c46bf2f34.png[/img]

We’re really happy with how it turned out, and we think it fits the game perfectly. Hope you all like it too! 😊

We’d love to hear your thoughts and detailed feedback on the new logo—it would mean a lot! And if you want to chat more with us, we’re most active on Discord, so be sure to drop by!

===============================

[b]P.S.[/b]

We’d love to communicate with you all more often and hear your thoughts on the game. But since we’re still deep in development, there aren’t always major updates to share.

That said, we’ll make an effort to keep you posted on even the small things—so stay tuned! Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and we can’t wait to make Rivals Hover League the best it can be! 🚀💙
